title: Green Line Lattice From Idea to First Users
whatItIs: A black tall post with a white logo top left, thousands of thin green lines fanning from two edges into a curved lattice, a bold white headline 'From Idea To First Users.', a small paragraph and a footer of website, handle and an arrow.
whatItMeans: String-art lines curving across the top give a technical elegance with a single colour and no imagery.
techniques: String-art lattice made of fine lines
Small paragraph and footer as a quiet base
Diagonal arrow icon as the exit cue

vocabulary.definition: Straight lines arranged to create curved shapes.
A grid formed by crossing line bundles.
A base row holding the site, handle and arrow.
